issues.detail: Hebrew 'בְּֽלֹא י֭וֹמוֹ' means 'before its day/time' (i.e., before its time), but Vietnamese 'Trước kỳ người chưa đến' adds 'người chưa đến' (the person has not yet come), introducing a person not in the Hebrew and changing the meaning to 'before the person arrives' instead of 'before its time'.
